headline_seed: St Petersburg oil facilities ablaze as Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia - AP News
draft_text:
Ukrainian drones struck St. Petersburg overnight, killing 1 and wounding 5, per Gov. Beglov. Russia's Defense Ministry claims 1,015 drones downed. BBC News and AP both report fires at the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal and Ruchi oil depot.

And that's the mews.
